title: epan: Add increment and decrement dissection depth by n functions
description:
Add functions that increment and decrement dissection depth by an
unsigned number. Check for overflow and underflow. Make
pinfo->dissection_depth unsigned, so the ckd_sub underflow is
the same as going below zero. This allow removing a cast when
comparing to the maximum dissection depth, which is an unsigned.

Change asn2wrs.py to use the new functions. Note that it was
incrementing and decrementing by one too much previously.

AI-Assisted: no
